title: HVAC Dispatch Flow - Quote, Schedule, Invoice
description: A managed HVAC proposal-to-cash workflow for small service teams.
headline: From missed call to paid job - without the clipboard relay.
subheadline: One managed path captures the request, prepares an estimate, reserves the crew, and hands the completed job to invoicing.
buyer_signal: The owner or dispatcher retypes the same job into an inbox, estimate, calendar, and invoice system.
outcome: Every service request has one owner and one next action.
before: Voicemails, texts, handwritten notes, and calendar changes leave estimates slow and follow-up uneven.
after: A qualified request moves through approved estimate, dispatch, completion, and invoice follow-up with visible gates.

steps.name: Intake
steps.detail: Capture system, urgency, address, and access window.

steps.name: Estimate
steps.detail: Prepare scope and price for owner approval.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.detail: Reserve a crew window and dispatch brief.

steps.name: Invoice
steps.detail: Draft the final invoice from approved work.

steps.name: Follow-up
steps.detail: Queue the correct receipt, reminder, or review task.

benefits.title: Faster estimates
benefits.detail: Required details arrive before the owner starts pricing.

benefits.title: Cleaner dispatch
benefits.detail: The technician sees the accepted scope and access notes in one handoff.

benefits.title: Visible cash follow-up
benefits.detail: Every completed job produces an invoice task with a due date.

faq.question: Does this replace our field-service platform?
faq.answer: No. The first version connects the narrow handoffs around the tools you already use.

faq.question: Can it price repair work automatically?
faq.answer: It can prepare a draft from approved rules, but a human approves scope and price before anything is sent.

faq.question: Does the page collect payment?
faq.answer: No. The included Stripe preset is disabled and cannot make API calls.

faq.question: What is included in managed care?
faq.answer: Monitoring, small fixes, and one monthly workflow tune-up after the setup handoff.
